Provides expertise on the design and participates in building of data infrastructure to optimize data processing from a variety of data sources. Independently designs and implements data governance policies and procedures for data handling to manage data consistency, integrity, accuracy, and reliability. Provides expertise on and participates in the design and implementation of rigorous data validation and integrity checks, proactively mitigating data quality issues that could impact data pipeline and model performance. Leverages advanced knowledge of Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) processes to design, develop, and optimize automated, scalable, and efficient data pipeline architectures to build reusable data products. Works independently and collaboratively in an agile development environment with other engineers to develop, maintain, and debug advanced data solutions that are scalable, efficient, cost effective, and reliable.
Key Responsibilities
Data Processing & Pipelining – Data Requirements, Collection, and Infrastructure:
Mentors less experienced team members to identify data requirements and business objectives of a project or initiative.
Provides expertise on the design and participates in building of data infrastructure to optimize data processing from a variety of data sources.
Independently analyzes, designs, and troubleshoots data flows based on business needs.
Participates and designs architecture, performance, and security reviews of the technical solution.
Adjusts data collection processes that involve indexing and query optimizations for optimal performance.
Builds Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) pipelines to support efficient and scalable data collection and extraction.
Engages with and holds the upstream and downstream teams accountable for the predefined service level agreements (SLAs).
Manages relationships with the data providers.
Data Processing & Pipelining – Data Governance:
Independently designs and implements data governance policies and procedures for data handling (e.g., data retention) to manage data consistency, integrity, accuracy, and reliability throughout the data lifecycle.
Leads the execution of redaction processes for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Protected Health Information (PHI) data, ensuring compliance with data privacy and security standards.
Ensures minimal data collection and usage in accordance with data minimization principles.
Follows data security measures to protect data from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, alteration, or destruction, proactively identifying and escalating potential issues.
Ensures data compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards.
Data Processing & Pipelining – Data Validation & Quality Assurance:
Provides expertise on and participates in the design and implementation of rigorous data validation and integrity checks, proactively mitigating data quality issues that could impact data pipeline and model performance.
Mentors less experienced team members to define data annotation and labeling processes to ensure data quality.
Identifies opportunities for automation of data validation and governance, and implements them.
Independently corrects deviations and non-conformance when identified.
Data Pipeline and Solutions Engineering – Pipeline Design:
Leverages advanced knowledge of ETL processes to design, develop, and optimize automated, scalable, and efficient data pipeline architectures to build reusable data products.
Implements advanced data storage solutions to store the processed data to be used in a scalable, optimized, and efficient way for access and analysis.
Mentors less experienced team members to manage the flow of data pipeline and storage day-to-day operations.
Data Pipeline and Solutions Engineering – Data Solutions Engineering:
Works independently and collaboratively in an agile development environment with other engineers to develop, maintain, and debug advanced data solutions that are scalable, efficient, cost effective, and reliable.
Reviews runnable code and works on testing and debugging of data solutions with less experienced team members.
Evaluates new technologies to create more robust data solutions.
Enforces and documents code standards and guidance within the team.
Creates documentation for design decisions, and obtains feedback from the broader architecture team before implementing.
Gathers data and evidence to secure necessary approvals.
Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:
Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative.
Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
Collaboration & Partnership:
Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives.
Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs.
Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
Problem Solving:
Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices.
Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions.
Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
Continuous Learning:
Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices.
Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills.
Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
Continuous Improvement:
Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders.
Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
Performance and Development:
Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

Role Overview
We are looking for a highly technical, execution-oriented Cloud Solutions Engineer to drive complex engineering engagements across a portfolio of strategic OCI customers.
This role combines cloud architecture and technical leadership with strong technical program management skills . The Cloud Solutions Engineer works across customers, OCI Product Engineering, systems integrators, Oracle delivery services, and account teams to turn technical priorities into coordinated execution.
The ideal candidate can understand the architecture and engineering problem, engage credibly with technical stakeholders, and then drive the people, dependencies, decisions, and deliverables required to achieve the customer outcome.
What You’ll Do
Drive Technical Execution
Lead complex technical initiatives from architecture and planning through production adoption.
Translate customer priorities into clear technical plans with milestones, deliverables, owners, dependencies, and success criteria.
Understand architectures deeply enough to identify technical risks, challenge assumptions, and help teams determine the right path forward.
Coordinate customer engineering teams, systems integrators, Oracle delivery services, and OCI engineering around a common execution plan.
Drive technical evaluations, migrations, modernization efforts, and new workload adoption.
Orchestrate Engineering Engagement
Coordinate engineering engagement across multiple OCI services and organizations.
Work directly with OCI Product Engineering to resolve blockers, manage dependencies, and deliver capabilities required by strategic workloads.
Maintain clear ownership and accountability for engineering commitments.
Drive cross-functional decisions and escalate issues when progress or customer outcomes are at risk.
Ensure blockers remain actively managed through resolution rather than simply tracked.
Create Visibility & Accountability
Maintain a clear view of workload milestones, engineering deliverables, risks, dependencies, and decisions.
Establish an effective operating cadence across complex customer engagements.
Communicate what changed, what matters, what is blocked, and what action or decision is required .
Provide concise reporting to technical and executive stakeholders.
Identify patterns across customers that require broader Product Engineering or leadership action.
Support the Customer Lifecycle
Adoption: Drive the technical execution required to move strategic workloads into production.
Growth: Coordinate engineering engagement around technical health, blockers, new capabilities, and expansion opportunities.
Pursuits: Lead and program-manage technical evaluations and engineering engagements required to win new workloads.
What Success Looks Like
Strategic workloads consistently advance through technical milestones and into production.
Engineering commitments have clear owners and are delivered against agreed timelines.
Technical and product blockers are identified early and driven to resolution.
Customers, partners, delivery teams, and OCI engineering remain aligned on priorities and responsibilities.
Customer-facing teams have a clear view of technical progress, risk, and required decisions.
Product Engineering receives clear, prioritized requirements tied to customer and workload impact.
Technical engagements result in production adoption, improved customer outcomes, or new workload wins.
Preferred Experience
Ideal candidates will have experience with:
Cloud architecture, infrastructure, or large-scale distributed systems.
OCI or another major public cloud platform.
Driving complex technical programs spanning customers, engineering, partners, and delivery organizations.
Enterprise migration, modernization, cloud-native, AI, or data workloads.
Working with Product Engineering on product gaps, roadmap dependencies, escalations, and new capabilities.
Managing technical milestones, dependencies, risks, and cross-functional deliverables.
Communicating complex technical programs clearly to both engineering and executive audiences.
The strongest candidates combine technical depth with exceptional execution discipline . They can engage engineers on architecture and technical tradeoffs, create structure around ambiguous problems, hold stakeholders accountable, and drive complex cross-organizational efforts through to measurable customer outcomes.

oracle-348711.text:
The Principal Security Engineer provides technical leadership and hands-on engineering for security data platforms, reporting applications, and analytics that help operational teams and leadership understand enterprise security posture and make informed risk decisions. The role designs, builds, and operates automated data pipelines, repeatable security metric calculations, and reporting solutions that turn data from multiple systems into accurate, traceable, and actionable information.
Working with security subject matter experts, engineering teams, and program leadership, this engineer translates complex measurement needs into secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions. The role resolves integration and data-quality challenges, applies sound architectural judgment, and independently delivers complex engineering initiatives. It develops and integrates AI-enabled capabilities to improve analysis and reporting, with appropriate validation, human review, and data-access controls.
The Principal Security Engineer owns solutions from design through deployment, ongoing operation, and continuous improvement, while providing technical guidance and strengthening shared engineering practices.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Security Data Integration and Engineering
Designs, builds, and maintains automated integrations that collect data from security tools, enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and other source systems.
Establishes centralized data structures and ingestion workflows that support reliable security measurement, historical analysis, and reporting, with appropriate validation, error handling, monitoring, and recovery capabilities.
Partners with security and engineering teams to assess source-system coverage, data availability, refresh requirements, integration dependencies, and ownership.
Replaces manual data collection with supported automation while maintaining data quality, validation, and clear accountability.
Evolves the integration architecture to accommodate additional data sources, metrics, and reporting needs while balancing near-term delivery with long-term maintainability.
Data Modeling and Metric Implementation
Translates security measurement requirements into documented data models, transformation logic, and repeatable metric calculations.
Normalizes and reconciles data across systems, addressing inconsistent definitions, duplicate records, incomplete coverage, and differences in reporting periods.
Implements and validates metric calculations, baselines, and trends using definitions and targets agreed with security subject matter experts and program leadership.
Maintains traceability from reported metrics to source data, calculation logic, and applicable scope; preserves historical results and manages calculation changes so reporting remains explainable and comparable over time.
Investigates and communicates data-quality issues, measurement limitations, and assumptions, recommending improvements that strengthen the accuracy and interpretation of security reporting.
Dashboard and Reporting Application Development
Develops and maintains dashboards and reporting applications using Oracle APEX or comparable technologies.
Translates leadership and operational reporting needs into clear, usable views, incorporating stakeholder feedback and perspectives from different reporting audiences.
Provides appropriate drill-down capabilities so users can investigate results and understand the factors contributing to changes in security posture.
Builds data submission, validation, review, and publication workflows where automated source integration is not yet available.
Evaluates whether visualizations accurately communicate the intended security outcomes and improves reporting usability, performance, and maintainability through iterative development.
Automation and AI-Enabled Analytics
Designs, develops, and integrates AI-enabled features into security data platforms, dashboards, and reporting workflows.
Evaluates and applies generative AI, large language models, and other analytical techniques to support natural-language exploration, contextual analysis, reporting automation, anomaly detection, and forecasting where appropriate.
Connects AI-enabled functionality to authoritative security data and metric definitions, maintaining source traceability and enforcing audience-specific access controls.
Establishes evaluation and validation methods to assess accuracy, reliability, and usefulness, with appropriate human review of generated interpretations and recommendations.
Monitors and improves AI-enabled features as data, models, and requirements evolve, using defined measures to assess effectiveness and guide further investment.
Security, Permissions, and Access Controls
Designs and implements role-based access and least-privilege permissions for data contributors, reviewers, administrators, and reporting audiences.
Partners with identity, infrastructure, and security teams to integrate authentication and authorization with enterprise standards.
Applies secure credential handling and appropriate controls to protect sensitive security data.
Implements logging and auditability for relevant data changes, administrative actions, and reporting workflows.
Incorporates security requirements into application design, development, testing, and operation, including AI-enabled functionality.
Reliability and Operational Ownership
Owns developed integrations and reporting applications through deployment, ongoing operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement.
Establishes testing, version control, deployment practices, and technical documentation that support reliable changes and maintainable solutions.
Monitors data freshness, processing failures, completeness, and reporting availability; investigates issues using structured analysis and coordinates resolution with relevant teams.
Supports scheduled reporting and leadership review cycles by validating readiness, addressing issues within agreed delivery windows, and communicating delivery risks.
Develops runbooks and recovery procedures, coordinates database, hosting, and platform requirements, and incorporates operational lessons into engineering practices.
Technical Leadership and Collaboration
Independently scopes and delivers complex engineering initiatives, identifies dependencies, estimates effort, and communicates progress, risks, and tradeoffs.
Works with security subject matter experts to understand controls, operational processes, and source data; identifies gaps in requirements, data coverage, and proposed solutions.
Builds effective partnerships across security, engineering, infrastructure, and program teams, aligning implementation plans with stakeholder needs and establishing clear ownership and delivery expectations.
Applies sound technical judgment to resolve ambiguity and adjust plans as priorities or constraints change; escalates unresolved issues with an assessment of impact and recommended options.
Expands relevant technical knowledge, mentors colleagues, documents and shares solutions, and contributes to shared engineering practices.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
Education and Experience
One of the following:
11 years of experience in IT security, developing security reporting solutions, such as cloud, endpoint, or logging; vulnerability and risk assessment; identity and access management; compliance; or a related field.
OR
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Security, Engineering, or a related field, and 7 years of experience in IT security, such as cloud, endpoint, or logging; vulnerability and risk assessment; identity and access management; compliance; or a related field.
OR
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Security, Engineering, or a related field, and 5 years of experience in IT security, such as cloud, endpoint, or logging; vulnerability and risk assessment; identity and access management; compliance; or a related field.
Technical and Security Experience
Demonstrated knowledge across multiple cybersecurity domains and experience working with security subject matter experts to interpret controls, risks, data sources, and measurement limitations.
Strong SQL and relational database skills, including schema design, data modeling, query development, and performance optimization.
Experience building and maintaining automated data pipelines, API integrations, and data transformation processes.
Proficiency in a programming or scripting language used for integration and automation, such as Python.
Experience developing dashboards, reporting applications, or analytical tools for operational and leadership audiences.
Hands-on experience developing and integrating AI-enabled application features, including evaluating output quality and implementing appropriate data-access and security controls.
Experience implementing data validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to support trustworthy reporting.
Understanding of authentication, authorization, role-based access, and secure handling of sensitive data.
Experience applying testing, version control, documentation, and deployment practices to production solutions.
Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into practical technical solutions, identify dependencies, and communicate tradeoffs clearly.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Experience developing applications with Oracle APEX , including SQL and PL/SQL.
Experience with Oracle Database, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, or comparable cloud data and application platforms.
Experience integrating data from multiple cybersecurity domains, such as vulnerability management, asset management, identity and access management, endpoint security, security monitoring, or cloud security.
Experience implementing security posture metrics, executive reporting, and historical trend analysis.
Experience applying AI-enabled capabilities to enterprise data analysis and reporting, including validating outputs and enforcing appropriate data access controls.
Familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, or CIS Controls.
Experience establishing a new data or reporting capability and transitioning manual processes into supported automation.
Experience working across a large organization with distributed data ownership and multiple stakeholder groups.
Relevant security certifications, such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Certified Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Security Professional .

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Cloud Architect - Retail and Hospitality
Oracle
As the provider of the world's most complete, open, and integrated cloud applications and platform services, Oracle is dedicated to helping organizations innovate, transform, and lead in the digital economy.
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) delivers the industry's most secure, performant, and cost-effective cloud platform for enterprise workloads. Built to run mission-critical applications, OCI provides customers with unmatched performance, security, availability, and flexibility while enabling organizations to accelerate innovation and business transformation.
Oracle continues to experience significant growth across cloud infrastructure and platform services as organizations modernize applications, data platforms, and enterprise workloads. OCI's differentiated architecture, multicloud capabilities, and enterprise-grade services position Oracle as a strategic partner for customers navigating their cloud transformation journeys.
Position Overview
Oracle is seeking a highly accomplished OCI Cloud Architect to join the North America Cloud Engineering organization. This strategic presales role combines deep cloud infrastructure expertise, executive engagement skills, and business acumen to help customers modernize their IT environments and accelerate adoption of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
The successful candidate will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, sales teams, and Oracle leadership while driving strategic opportunities from discovery through technical win and customer adoption. This individual will engage directly with executives, architects, developers, and operations teams to design innovative cloud solutions that solve complex business and technical challenges.
As a recognized technical leader, the OCI Cloud Architect will influence customer cloud strategies, support Oracle's largest and most strategic opportunities, and help customers realize the full value of OCI's infrastructure services.
Key Responsibilities
Partner with sales teams to identify, qualify, and advance strategic OCI opportunities across enterprise and commercial accounts.
Build trusted advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects, Infrastructure Leaders, Cloud Centers of Excellence, and executive stakeholders.
Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer business objectives, existing environments, modernization strategies, and cloud adoption initiatives.
Architect and present innovative OCI solutions that address customer requirements while demonstrating Oracle's technical and business differentiation.
Develop executive-level presentations, solution architectures, technical proposals, migration strategies, and business value assessments.
Serve as the technical lead for strategic pursuits, coordinating cross-functional Oracle resources to support complex customer engagements.
Design enterprise-scale cloud architectures spanning compute, storage, networking, security, containers, databases, AI services, observability, disaster recovery, and multicloud environments.
Lead customer workshops, architecture reviews, proof-of-concepts, technical deep dives, and solution validation activities.
Help customers evaluate cloud migration strategies, application modernization initiatives, and hybrid or multicloud architectures.
Position OCI's unique capabilities, including distributed cloud offerings, sovereign cloud, multicloud partnerships, and enterprise-grade performance and security.
Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, Consulting, and Partner organizations to ensure successful customer outcomes.
Provide competitive intelligence, market insights, and customer feedback to influence Oracle's product strategy and go-to-market initiatives.
Mentor and guide less experienced solution engineers and architects while promoting technical excellence across the organization.
Year One Critical Success Factors
Establish credibility as a trusted technical advisor with customers and Oracle sales teams.
Develop strong relationships across Cloud Engineering, Sales, Product Management, Customer Success, and Engineering organizations.
Demonstrate mastery of OCI services, architectures, competitive positioning, and Oracle's cloud value proposition.
Influence and contribute to multiple strategic cloud opportunities resulting in significant bookings and customer adoption.
Build executive relationships within key target accounts and become a recognized subject matter expert in cloud infrastructure and modernization.
Deliver impactful customer engagements that accelerate pipeline growth, technical wins, and cloud consumption.
Create reusable technical assets, reference architectures, best practices, and enablement content that improve organizational effectiveness.
Preferred Experience, Characteristics, and Technical Skills
The ideal candidate is a customer-focused technical leader with deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, enterprise architecture, and large-scale technology transformation initiatives. This individual combines strong business acumen with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business outcomes.
The successful candidate will have:
10+ years of experience in cloud architecture, solution engineering, technical consulting, enterprise architecture, or related customer-facing technical roles.
Proven success supporting complex enterprise technology sales cycles and strategic customer engagements.
Deep expertise in public cloud platforms, cloud infrastructure, networking, security, application modernization, and enterprise architecture.
Experience designing and implementing large-scale cloud migration and modernization initiatives.
Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure, virtualization, storage, networking, identity management, security, and operations.
Experience engaging senior executives including CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects, Infrastructure Leaders, and business executives.
Demonstrated ability to lead large, complex technical pursuits involving multiple stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
Strong knowledge of enterprise technology buying cycles and the factors influencing customer decision-making.
Exceptional communication, presentation, storytelling, and executive engagement skills.
Ability to articulate technical concepts in business terms and align solutions to customer outcomes.
Strong collaboration skills and the ability to influence without direct authority.
Passion for customer success and a proven ability to build long-term trusted advisor relationships.

Experience in several of the following areas is highly desirable:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
Public cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud)
Hybrid and Multicloud architectures
Cloud networking and security
Kubernetes and container platforms
Infrastructure as Code and automation
Cloud-native application architectures
Disaster recovery and business continuity
Identity and access management
Enterprise application modernization

Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI services
Observability, monitoring, and operational excellence

Principal Site Reliability Engineer – Oracle Health US
Strengthen the Reliability of Technology That Powers Healthcare
Oracle Health is advancing healthcare through reliable, scalable technology that healthcare organizations depend on every day. We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer to join our team supporting services and infrastructure for a diverse group of customers in a multi-tenant environment. Our team works together to keep services healthy, respond to complex incidents, and turn operational insights into lasting improvements.
This is a hands-on engineering role focused on troubleshooting, automation, and service reliability. You will investigate issues across interconnected services, participate in on-call support, and build tools that improve monitoring, accelerate recovery, and prevent recurring incidents. You will also explore AI-powered automation and AIOps to help the team anticipate issues and strengthen operations.
We are looking for engineers who thrive in complex technical environments, bring strong problem-solving skills, and take ownership from incident response through root cause analysis and prevention. If you enjoy collaborating across teams and using Python, Java, SQL, shell scripting, Kubernetes, databases, and public cloud technologies to solve meaningful challenges, join us in supporting the technology behind healthcare.
Leverages advanced knowledge to perform incident triage, response, root cause analysis. Identifies and recommends opportunities for automation and develop automation. Communicates comprehensive information about services and proactively anticipates and articulates the potential impact of changes. Provides comprehensive support for technology and documents incidents. Conducts experiments with AI based tools like codex and others and develops and maintains advanced knowledge of AIOps trends.
This is a full time remote role working for Oracle in the US. This position does not offer sponsorship and candidates must be US Citizens for consideration
Key Responsibilities
Troubleshooting and Resolution:
- Provides operational support for technology, incidents and issues arising within Oracle Healthcare services and Infrastructure.
- Drives and actively participates in on-call shifts to address issues.
- Executes the resolution of technical issues spanning multiple services, applying advanced investigation and debugging techniques to achieve SLAs for incident response, mitigation, and resolution
- Documents incidents according to reporting methods and performs root cause analyses, capturing essential information for analysis and future reference.
- Performs post-mortem procedures to prevent incident reoccurrence.
Automation:
- Identifies and implement opportunities for automation
- Develops and implements design, automation tools, or scripts to provide solutions, gather metrics, monitor, analyze, mitigate, or remediate issues/defects using AIOps
- Conducts testing on moderately complex automations to ensure they perform tasks correctly and produce expected results.
Incident and Service Lifecycle Management:
- Exercises judgment when performing data collection, triage, technical analysis, and redirection to maintain and optimize operations and infrastructure reliability.
- Takes proactive steps to monitor services, maintain up-to-date knowledge of their performance, and document their condition.
- Leverages advanced knowledge to perform incident response, root cause analyses.
- Provides comprehensive health and performance reporting and takes appropriate actions based on trends in data.
Innovation and Improvement:
- Conducts experiments and evaluations of cutting-edge tools and technologies to build proactive monitoring tools and automations using AI tools like Codex, AIOps etc.
Tech Stack:
- Experience with Python, Java, SQL, Shell-Scripts, Kubernetes, Database and public cloud.
Core Responsibilities
Problem Solving:
- Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
Collaboration & Partnership:
- Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs.
Continuous Learning:
- Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest AI industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
Performance and Development:
- Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

oracle-349025.text:
Build the Platforms That Healthcare Depends On
Behind every dependable healthcare application is infrastructure that has to work. Oracle Health’s Core Platform Operations (CPO) team supports the core platforms that help run Millennium, spanning Linux infrastructure, Application Tier, WebSphere, Distributed File Systems, Business Objects, and Citrix. Our mission is to keep these platforms reliable, secure, and ready for the healthcare organizations that depend on them, while making them easier to maintain and improve.
Our work connects Linux engineering with the behavior of the services running above it. You might trace a performance issue through a server and its middleware dependencies, improve a health check, or turn a repeated maintenance task into reusable automation. Across the team, we use rolling maintenance and canary environments to introduce changes with care. Current initiatives also include developing maintenance orchestration to reduce manual effort and human error. You’ll collaborate with application, networking, security, and infrastructure partners, learn how the pieces fit together, and help turn difficult operational problems into better engineering.
Your Role
As a Principal Site Reliability Engineer, you’ll manage, maintain, and enhance physical and virtual Linux servers across production and nonproduction environments. You’ll bring deep technical judgment to system configuration, performance tuning, security patching, capacity planning, and complex troubleshooting, while helping shape the standards and tools the team uses every day.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role with technical leadership responsibilities. You’ll guide engineering decisions, mentor colleagues, and turn operational findings into lasting improvements. You’ll also participate in on-call support and serve as an escalation resource for the services within your scope.
Why This Work Is Worth Doing
If you enjoy following a problem from an application symptom down to the Linux processes, network connections, or resource constraints behind it, there is plenty to explore here. You’ll have opportunities to build useful tools, influence how infrastructure is operated, and see your improvements make daily work better for other engineers. Bring your curiosity, share what you learn, and help us solve the next problem more effectively than the last.
What You Will Do
• Engineer and operate Linux infrastructure. Configure, update, maintain, and troubleshoot physical and virtual Linux servers across production and nonproduction environments, with a focus on availability, performance, stability, and security.
• Guide reliable design. Evaluate infrastructure configurations and service dependencies, identify failure points, and recommend practical improvements to reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
• Understand and improve performance. Analyze CPU, memory, storage, filesystem, process, and network behavior. Forecast resource needs, investigate bottlenecks, and tune systems using measured results.
• Strengthen monitoring. Improve metrics, logging, health checks, and actionable alerts. Use service trends and service-level objectives to identify degradation and prioritize engineering work.
• Resolve complex incidents. Apply a methodical approach to diagnosis across operating systems, applications, networking, storage, and related dependencies. Coordinate with partner teams to restore service and communicate findings clearly.
• Prevent recurring failures. Perform root cause analysis and post-incident reviews. Translate findings into corrective actions, better diagnostics, runbooks, and engineering improvements.
• Maintain secure systems. Apply security patches and updates, remediate vulnerabilities, strengthen configurations and access controls, and maintain compliance with applicable security standards and policies.
• Make production changes safely. Plan maintenance, assess dependencies and risk, prepare rollback procedures, and validate system and application behavior after changes.
• Automate repeatable work. Develop, test, document, and maintain Bash, Python, Ansible, or comparable automation for configuration, maintenance, monitoring, and recovery. Use version control and peer review to keep changes traceable and maintainable.
• Support application delivery. Partner with developers, network engineers, security teams, and other IT staff on deployments, environment readiness, connectivity, and server-related requirements.
• Improve resilience and recovery. Help validate backup, restore, and recovery procedures for assigned systems, and address gaps that could delay service restoration.
• Build team capability. Maintain architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and change records. Mentor colleagues, share knowledge, and communicate technical risks and recommendations to stakeholders.
• Contribute to dependable support coverage. Participate in on-call rotations and planned maintenance, provide escalation support for assigned services, and improve the documentation and tooling that make support more effective.
What You Will Bring
• Extensive hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting Linux systems in production, including physical and virtual server environments.
• Strong knowledge of Linux internals, system services, processes, permissions, filesystems, logs, and resource utilization, with the ability to investigate performance and stability issues.
• Practical scripting and automation experience with Bash, Python, Ansible, or comparable tools, including testing, troubleshooting, and maintaining reusable solutions.
• Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, ports, certificates, and connectivity troubleshooting across application and infrastructure dependencies.
• Experience with security patching, vulnerability remediation, secure configuration, access controls, and production change management.
• Experience monitoring system health, responding to incidents, investigating root causes, and implementing improvements that reduce recurring problems.
• Demonstrated technical leadership through sound engineering decisions, cross-team collaboration, mentoring, and clear documentation.
• A curious, methodical approach to problem solving and the ability to explain findings, tradeoffs, risks, and next steps to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Experience That Would Help You Get Started
• Experience supporting Oracle Health, Millennium, Cerner applications, or other healthcare or regulated production environments.
• Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure or other cloud platforms, hybrid environments, and infrastructure modernization.
• Familiarity with middleware and application hosting, including WebSphere or WebLogic, and the Linux infrastructure those services depend on.
• Experience with configuration management, infrastructure as code, deployment pipelines, REST APIs, observability, or resilience and recovery testing.

The Senior HR Data Analyst leverages workforce and financial data to provide actionable insights to HR leadership and business teams, with a particular focus on headcount and workforce planning. This role is deeply collaborative, partnering with HRBPs, Finance, Business Operations, and business leaders to provide trusted data and analysis across compensation, hiring, attrition, and other workforce cost drivers.
By reconciling complex data, developing workforce forecasts and scenarios, identifying the drivers behind cost and headcount variances, and translating those findings into clear business implications, the Senior HR Data Analyst helps leaders better understand and actively manage workforce investment. Success in this role requires strong analytical, financial, and consultative skills; exceptional attention to detail; and the ability to independently investigate discrepancies, solve ambiguous data issues, and partner across functions to drive issues to resolution.
Key Responsibilities
Partner directly with Finance, HRBPs, Business Operations, and business leaders to translate ambiguous workforce questions into structured analyses that support budget alignment, headcount allocation, and informed workforce decisions.
Build headcount forecasts and workforce supply/demand scenario models using historical trends, attrition data, hiring pipelines, and other relevant workforce inputs to quantify the workforce cost impact of hiring, employee movement, and organization changes.
Reconcile workforce, headcount, and cost data across HR, Finance, and other data sources; investigate discrepancies and variances, identify root causes, and clearly explain differences in definitions, timing, organizational hierarchy, or underlying source data.
Serve as a subject matter expert on people and workforce planning data, tools, and resources; guide and consult with stakeholders in accessing, interpreting, and effectively using workforce planning information.
Exercise sound judgment and ensure responsible handling and release of sensitive employee and compensation data, adhering to applicable data governance, privacy, and security standards.
Use advanced Excel, Oracle reporting and analytics tools, and other relevant analytical technologies to reconcile data, automate repeatable analyses, build forecasts and scenarios, identify trends, and provide actionable workforce insights.
Work independently to prioritize multiple requests and resolve complex data issues in a fast-paced, agile environment, demonstrating strong ownership, analytical rigor, attention to detail, and accountability.
Proactively learn the business and identify emerging workforce cost, capacity, and talent risks and opportunities; partner with HRBPs and business leaders to determine where deeper analysis or intervention may be needed.
Preferred Qualifications
An advanced College or University degree in Data Management, Data Science, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Industrial/Organizational Psychology, or a related quantitative field.
5+ years of experience in people analytics, workforce analytics, workforce planning, financial analysis, compensation analytics, business analytics, or a related analytical discipline.
Experience developing headcount forecasts, workforce supply/demand models, scenario analyses, or other forward-looking workforce planning analyses.
Experience analyzing or reconciling workforce costs, budgets, headcount, compensation, labor costs, or other financial measures.
Experience partnering across HR, Finance, Business Operations, and/or business leadership on workforce planning, headcount allocation, budgeting, or cost-management activities.
Experience supporting, testing, implementing, or driving adoption of analytical tools, reporting products, or business applications.
Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM, OTBI, BI Publisher, Oracle Analytics Cloud, and/or workforce planning and financial management tools.
Location: Seeking candidates in Nashville, TN metro area or willing to relocate to Nashville.

Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
The Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer will lead the development and management of software solutions that integrate with advanced networking technologies. This role involves defining and adhering to delivery procedures for software projects to achieve high-level objectives. The candidate will frequently serve as the module lead, collaborating with both senior and junior engineers to ensure the timely delivery of projects and working closely with stakeholders to align with organizational goals.
As a technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) with a focus on networking, the Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer will take ownership of moderately complex projects, including the development of software for network operating systems and related infrastructure. This role requires translating detailed software designs into actionable development plans, leading the creation of solutions that span multiple modules with intricate interactions, and ensuring these solutions are effectively supported by monitoring and automation systems.
In this capacity, the candidate will act as an SME for root cause analysis, often automating complex tasks that bridge software and networking functions. They may also lead software automation design and delivery projects specifically tailored to enhance network operations.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field is preferred.
At least 5 years of experience in software engineering with a focus on networking.
Strong expertise in Network Operating Systems (NOS) and experience with networking hardware.
Proven experience in developing software solutions for large enterprises or cloud provider environments.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C/C++, Java, or similar.
Solid knowledge of networking protocols (e.g., BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, TCP/IP) and technologies (e.g., VPN, DNS, DHCP, MPLS).
Experience with network automation, scripting, and tooling (e.g., Python, Ansible).
Familiarity with network modeling and programming (e.g., YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF).
Knowledge of software architecture and design, particularly in distributed systems and cloud-native environments.
Strong understanding of network security principles and best practices in software development.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, version control systems, and DevOps practices.
Knowledge of API development and integration, particularly in networking contexts.
Excellent organizational, verbal, and written communication skills.

GoldenGate Service is a new multi-tenant, cloud native service for real-time data integration and replication in heterogeneous IT environments. GoldenGate enables users to replicate and integrate data from different sources, including operational and analytics data, as well as real-time data streaming such as Apache Kafka. This service is expected to scale across thousands of tenants and enable transactional change data capture, data replication, transformations between systems. This cost effective data replication solution is engineered for highest performance and availability to run variety of data integration uses cases of the customers. This is a global team with locations in US, Hungary, Mexico and Oracle’s India Development Centre (IDC) Bangalore.
Our team owns the reliability, availability, operational excellence, and customer experience of these services. We work closely with software development, cloud infrastructure, and customer-facing teams to ensure our services remain secure, resilient, and highly available as adoption continues to grow across commercial and sovereign cloud environments. There is a high degree of autonomy required in this role and we are looking for engineers who want to help drive our roadmap.
This role offers the opportunity to solve complex distributed systems challenges, influence service reliability at scale, and contribute to cloud services used by enterprise customers around the world.
The ideal candidate will be technically strong and get a lot done. Automation is a core tenet for everything you do. You've made life easier and have motivated your team to make both process and service improvements.
Candidates should have broad working knowledge across multiple domains, but we love to see specialization as well. The basics we expect are: Networking, Linux Systems Engineering, Software Engineering/Automation, and Distributed Systems.
Learn more about OCI GoldenGate.
Experience/Qualifications:
This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.
7+ years production engineering experience (distributed services or cloud platform experience preferred)
Proven experience with automation and strong experience in a scripting language (bash, python, etc)
Solid understanding of Software Engineering and Computer Science principles
Solid foundation in Linux Systems Engineering
Solid understanding of Networking, Security and Storage
Experience with Docker
Understanding Infrastructure as Code concept
Experience with Terraform and/or Ansible
Experience in building fully automated CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Hudson, TeamCity, etc)
Be able to understand and formulate meaningful KPIs and business metrics
Experience in building/managing/operating cloud services at one of the big cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GPC or OCI) is a big plus
What You'll Do
As a Principal Site Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for the operational health, reliability, and continuous improvement of OCI GoldenGate and OCI Database Migration Service.
You will:
Operate and support production cloud services that power critical customer migration and data replication workloads.
Monitor service health, investigate incidents, and lead troubleshooting efforts for complex production issues.
Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews while driving corrective and preventative actions.
Act as ultimate escalation point for complex or critical issues that have not yet been documented as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Partner with software development teams to improve service architecture, reliability, scalability, and operational readiness.
Design and implement automation to reduce operational overhead and improve service efficiency.
Build and maintain observability solutions, including monitoring, alerting, logging, dashboards, and operational metrics.
Contribute to capacity planning, performance analysis, disaster recovery readiness, and service resilience initiatives.
Support services operating across Oracle Cloud commercial and sovereign cloud environments.
Leverage Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD practices to improve deployment consistency, scalability, and operational efficiency.
Drive continuous service improvement through operational reviews, reliability initiatives, and engineering best practices.
This role provides the opportunity to work on large-scale distributed systems supporting enterprise customers worldwide, helping shape the future of Oracle's cloud-native data movement platform. This role requires Professional curiosity and a desire to a develop deep understanding of services and technologies.
What We Offer
The opportunity to work on cloud services that support enterprise customers at global scale.
Exposure to complex distributed systems, cloud-native technologies, and large-scale operational challenges.
A collaborative environment where reliability, automation, and engineering excellence are core priorities.
Opportunities to influence service architecture, operational strategy, and platform evolution.
Career growth through ownership, technical leadership, and collaboration with world-class engineering teams.
Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and flexible work arrangements.

Job Description:
In this role you will be at the forefront of designing and implementing next-generation accelerated computing and AI solutions on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will engage directly with customers ranging from emerging AI startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, helping them architect and deploy complex HPC and GPU clusters, AI platforms, and intelligent agentic solutions across proof-of-concept and production environments.
This highly visible and influential role combines deep technical expertise with a consultative approach to pre-sales technical consulting, solution engineering, and AI transformation strategy. You will play a critical role in supporting OCI strategic customers by optimizing infrastructure for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
You will also help mature customer relationships by establishing strong partnerships with strategic customers and peers across OCI. In addition, you will develop and implement new processes

Work directly with strategic customers and partners across industry verticals to onboard, integrate, and optimize solutions on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
Architect and deploy large-scale GPU, HPC, and AI infrastructure on OCI using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Slurm, Kubernetes, and other automation frameworks.
Build automated solutions for cluster provisioning, software deployment, infrastructure as code, performance monitoring, and capacity planning.
Collaborate with Oracle’s largest enterprise customers to define, tailor, and validate solutions that meet high-performance computing, AI, and accelerated computing requirements.

The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) team can provide you the opportunity to build and operate a suite of massive scale, integrated cloud services in a broadly distributed, multi-tenant cloud environment. OCI is committed to providing the best in cloud products that meet the needs of our customers who are tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges.
As a Consulting Hardware Security Engineer you will be involved in ensuring that the compute hardware that is used in the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure meets the security bar to ensure compliance with our security posture. You will define security requirements for hardware ensuring hardware does not preclude inclusion of security controls essential to meet or exceed our posture. You will work closely across Oracle, with third party vendors, and with standards organization to influence the next generation of hardware platform security. You will also works closely with OCI's operations and engineering teams, constantly striving to improve Oracle Cloud's overall operational security posture by defining the supply chain and operational requirements to establish best practices for managing security for devices in our cloud infrastructure.
Our consulting hardware security engineers have a blend of hardware, firmware and security skills, enabling them to help design and assess our most complex compute systems.
Key Responsibilities
Definition of security requirements for hardware enabling OCI security posture aligning business needs and technology trends
Provide independent design consulting for complex compute systems, balancing business objective and security risks to implement:
requirements specified by the hardware security team
features required to achieve security bar
operations (provisioning, re-use, decommissioning) inline with security posture
Hands on
security assessments of complex compute systems to ensure they meets requirements.
adversarial assessments to ensure they can’t be compromised.
Breakdown complex systems for analysis, assign parts to other members of the team, collaborate on synthesizing the inputs and forming a holistic assessment, contextualized to cloud environments
Understand business objectives/requirements and assess risk from findings/threat models and identify proper risk mitigation controls
Work across to teams to ensure requirements, findings and recommendations are implemented inline with expected outcomes
Communicate risks and options to mitigate to senior leadership, balancing security, technology and business goals

Experience with reversing tools and ability to reverse engineer

OCI Incident Response is the first line of defense in maintaining the high availability of Oracle’s cloud. We minimize customer-impacting events by making them shorter, less frequent, and less impactful through large-scale incident management. We are at the forefront of reducing event duration by leveraging our operational experience, knowledge of best practices, and ability to develop tools that automate incident management.
Description
We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our OCI team. This role is part of a globally distributed team responsible for detecting, triaging, and mitigating OCI service-impacting events as quickly as possible. You will be part of one of these regional teams and will be responsible for minimizing the downtime of OCI services. You will achieve this by delivering excellent major incident management and operating systems with high scalability, performance, and security that help prevent incidents from occurring.
Oracle’s Cloud is state-of-the-art and constantly evolving. When issues arise, your team will respond within minutes to ensure customer impact is minimized. This role will expose you to the inner workings of OCI’s systems and organization. You will interact with and influence leaders across Oracle and drive broad, cross-organization programs aimed at iteratively improving OCI-wide service availability. We are an agile team with significant impact. If you want to be part of a fast-moving team breaking new ground, we would love to speak with you!
We are looking for candidates who are flexible to work AMER shift hours (9:30 AM to 5:30 PM PST) on a rotating roster, including occasional weekends and public holidays.
Career Level - IC3
Responsibilities:
Solve complex problems related to infrastructure cloud services and automate common tasks to ensure continuous availability with minimal human intervention.
Command and coordinate SMEs and service leaders to restore services as quickly as possible during major incidents, while keeping accurate and timely data on the progress of such incidents.
Utilize a deep understanding of cloud computing design patterns and their dependencies to mitigate complex major incidents.
Embed a methodical approach to troubleshoot large, complex, interconnected systems used in incident detection and orchestration.
Document pertinent information related to incidents that aids process improvement, identifies deviations, and enables the creation of an incident knowledge base.
Monitor and evaluate high-level service and infrastructure dashboards, taking action to address identified anomalies.
Identify opportunities and take ownership of automation and/or continuous improvement of incident management process steps and best practices.
Define and document the technical architecture of large-scale distributed systems.
Understand the end-to-end configuration, technical dependencies, and overall behavioral characteristics of production services.
Be responsible for the design and delivery of the mission-critical stack, with a focus on security, resiliency, scalability, and performance.
Partner with development teams to define operational requirements for product roadmaps.
Articulate the technical characteristics of services and technology areas, and guide development teams to engineer and add premier capabilities to the Oracle Cloud service portfolio.
Act as the ultimate escalation point for complex or critical issues that have not yet been documented as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or relevant work experience..
3+ years’ experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or System Engineering.
Must have public cloud operations experience (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI).
Extensive experience with Major Incident Management in a cloud-based environment.
Demonstrate clear understanding of automation and orchestration principles.
Experience having worked in at least one modern object-oriented programming language.
Experience with professional software engineering standard methodologies such as Agile project management, coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations.
Familiarity with infrastructure automation tools such as Chef, Ansible, Jenkins, Terraform
Excellent expertise with several of following technologies: Infrastructure-as-a-Service, CI/CD systems, Docker, RESTful APIs, log analysis tools, debugging tools

We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer 3 to support mission-critical cloud services and production operations. The role focuses on improving service reliability, reducing operational risk, automating repetitive tasks, and driving faster detection and resolution of issues.
The engineer will work closely with development, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to monitor service health, troubleshoot production issues, participate in incident response, improve observability, and implement reliability best practices. This role also includes analyzing recurring failures, building automation, supporting deployments, and contributing to capacity planning, disaster recovery, and operational readiness.
Also works on number of different region/realm rollouts, deployments. Forecasts demands and responds to capacity needs. Collaborates with software development teams to develop reliable and scalable infrastructures. Performs data collection to maintain and optimize operations and reliability. Leverages knowledge to perform incident response and/or maintenance tasks. Provides health and performance reporting. Identifies opportunities for automation. Communicates about services and identifies and explains the potential impact of changes. Provides support for technology and document incidents. Experiments with new tools and assesses potential impact and develops knowledge of site reliability trends.
Key Responsibilities
Capacity Ingestion and Management:
-Takes proactive steps to design and architect infrastructure and/or service according to terms for reliability and functionality.
-Forecasts demands for infrastructure and responds to capacity needs, ensuring systems have sufficient resources to handle current and future workloads.
-Collaborates with the software development team to develop infrastructures and features that are reliable and scalable according to deployment requirements.
-Independently identifies opportunities for and drives prototyping (e.g., testing new applications or infrastructures, assisting in onboarding).
Incident and Service Lifecycle Management:
-Performs data collection, triage, technical analysis, and redirection to maintain and optimize operations and infrastructure reliability.
-Independently monitors services, maintains up-to-date knowledge of their performance, and documents their condition.
-Leverages comprehensive knowledge to perform incident response, root cause analyses, and/or maintenance on assigned services (e.g., software installs, version upgrades, security updates, backup and recovery).
-Provides health and performance reporting and takes appropriate actions based on trends in data.
-May independently perform provisioning to support infrastructure, applications, and services.
-May perform standard and non-standard decommissioning (e.g., shutting down servers, removing data from databases) to remove objects that are no longer needed.
Automation:
-Identifies opportunities for automation and assesses potential benefits.
-Develops automation tools or scripts to provide solutions, gather metrics, monitor, analyze, mitigate, or remediate issues/defects within infrastructures.
-Independently conducts testing to ensure automation performs the task correctly and produces expected results.
Technical Communication and Guidance:
-Communicates the scale, capacity, security, performance attributes, and requirements of services and technology within and sometimes beyond immediate team.
-Identifies and explains the potential impact of infrastructure, feature, and tool changes, considering their impact on team operations.
Troubleshooting and Resolution:
-Provides operational support for technology, escalating incidents and other standard and non-standard issues arising within Oracle services.
-Participates in on-call shifts to address issues.
-Resolves technical issues spanning various services, investigating and debugging products in order to reach SLOs (service level objectives).
-Documents incidents and performs root cause analyses according to standard reporting methods.
-Independently performs post-mortem procedures to prevent incident reoccurrence.
Innovation and Improvement:
-Experiments with new tools and technologies to assess their potential impact on and improve infrastructure performance and reliability, ensuring adherence to security standards.
-Independently identifies and executes improvements for performance bottlenecks and deployments to ensure efficient resource usage, speed, and scalability.
-Develops knowledge of site reliability trends and shares new information with team members, management, and beyond to help others build, test, deploy and run services.
-Performs standard and non-standard analyses and provides clear data on production to contribute to business development decisions (e.g., design changes).
Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:
Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency.
Collaboration & Partnership:
Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.
Problem Solving:
Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices.
Continuous Learning:
Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.
Continuous Improvement:
Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts.
Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.
At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build the future of the cloud for enterprises. We combine the pace and ownership of a start-up with the scale, reliability, and customer focus required to run one of the world’s leading enterprise cloud platforms.
We are seeking a Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer to join our DNS Control Plane team. You will design, build, and operate the systems that safely configure and govern DNS at global scale—turning customer and platform intent into correct, auditable, and resilient DNS behavior across a distributed cloud.
What You’ll Do
Design and implement control-plane services and APIs for DNS zones, records, views, policies, and routing configuration.
Build reliable workflows for validation, change orchestration, propagation, reconciliation, and lifecycle management across distributed DNS infrastructure.
Develop production services and libraries primarily in Java, with supporting automation in Python where needed, and a strong focus on API design and correctness.
Use AI-assisted engineering tools and agentic workflows to accelerate implementation, testing, incident investigation, and operational automation, with appropriate human review, security, and quality controls.
Improve safety and operational resilience through idempotent workflows, optimistic concurrency, auditability, rollback paths, canary releases, and feature flags.
Own observability and operational readiness: metrics, logs, tracing, SLOs, runbooks, capacity planning, and thoughtful on-call participation.
Partner with DNS data plane, security, networking, and SRE teams to deliver secure, end-to-end platform improvements.
Contribute technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, documentation, and mentoring of other engineers.
Required Qualifications
8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and operating resilient production services.
4+ years of hands-on experience building production-grade distributed systems, cloud services, and/or control-plane platforms.
Strong proficiency in Java, including production service development, concurrent programming, and performance troubleshooting.
Demonstrated ability to use AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows to improve design, code generation, testing, troubleshooting, and process automation while maintaining strong engineering judgment.
Strong API design skills, including RESTful service design and OpenAPI/Swagger or comparable API contracts.
Experience designing reliable stateful workflows, including asynchronous processing, retries, idempotency, concurrency control, and failure recovery.
Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking fundamentals, and highly available distributed systems.
Experience with containers and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration automation, especially Terraform and tools such as Ansible or Chef.
Strong testing discipline across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, with a commitment to secure and safe rollout practices.
Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across organizational boundaries.
Preferred Qualifications
DNS expertise, including authoritative DNS, zone and record management, DNS delegation, TTLs, DNSSEC, and DNS change propagation.
Experience with cloud control planes, resource lifecycle management, or multi-tenant platform APIs.
Knowledge of internet protocols and security standards, including DNS, TLS, HTTP, and REST.
Experience with relational or distributed data stores and schema evolution for highly available services.
Familiarity with modern CI/CD platforms such as OCI DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI/CD, and engineering productivity tools including Bitbucket, Jira, and Confluence.
Experience operating mission-critical services in a 24/7 environment.
What Success Looks Like
You deliver control-plane capabilities that make DNS changes safer, faster, and easier for customers and internal operators.
You improve the reliability, auditability, and operability of DNS configuration workflows at scale.
You raise engineering standards through pragmatic design, rigorous testing, and collaborative technical leadership.

GoldenGate Service is a new multi-tenant, cloud native service for real-time data integration and replication in heterogeneous IT environments. GoldenGate enables users to replicate and integrate data from different sources, including operational and analytics data, as well as real-time data streaming such as Apache Kafka. This service is expected to scale across thousands of tenants and enable transactional change data capture, data replication, transformations between systems. This cost effective data replication solution is engineered for highest performance and availability to run variety of data integration uses cases of the customers. This is a global team with locations in US, Hungary, Mexico and Oracle’s India Development Centre (IDC) Bangalore.
Our team owns the reliability, availability, operational excellence, and customer experience of these services. We work closely with software development, cloud infrastructure, and customer-facing teams to ensure our services remain secure, resilient, and highly available as adoption continues to grow across commercial and sovereign cloud environments. There is a high degree of autonomy required in this role and we are looking for engineers who want to help drive our roadmap.
This role offers the opportunity to solve complex distributed systems challenges, influence service reliability at scale, and contribute to cloud services used by enterprise customers around the world.
The ideal candidate will be technically strong and get a lot done. Automation is a core tenet for everything you do. You've made life easier and have motivated your team to make both process and service improvements.
Candidates should have broad working knowledge across multiple domains, but we love to see specialization as well. The basics we expect are: Networking, Linux Systems Engineering, Software Engineering/Automation, and Distributed Systems.
Learn more about OCI GoldenGate.
Experience/Qualifications:
This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.
7+ years production engineering experience (distributed services or cloud platform experience preferred)
Proven experience with automation and strong experience in a scripting language (bash, python, etc)
Solid understanding of Software Engineering and Computer Science principles
Solid foundation in Linux Systems Engineering
Solid understanding of Networking, Security and Storage
Experience with Docker
Understanding Infrastructure as Code concept
Experience with Terraform and/or Ansible

Operate and support production cloud services that power critical customer migration and data replication workloads.
Monitor service health, investigate incidents, and lead troubleshooting efforts for complex production issues.

Design and implement automation to reduce operational overhead and improve service efficiency.
Build and maintain observability solutions, including monitoring, alerting, logging, dashboards, and operational metrics.

Support services operating across Oracle Cloud commercial and sovereign cloud environments.
Leverage Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD practices to improve deployment consistency, scalability, and operational efficiency.
Drive continuous service improvement through operational reviews, reliability initiatives, and engineering best practices.
This role provides the opportunity to work on large-scale distributed systems supporting enterprise customers worldwide, helping shape the future of Oracle's cloud-native data movement platform. This role requires Professional curiosity and a desire to a develop deep understanding of services and technologies.

The opportunity to work on cloud services that support enterprise customers at global scale.
Exposure to complex distributed systems, cloud-native technologies, and large-scale operational challenges.
A collaborative environment where reliability, automation, and engineering excellence are core priorities.
Opportunities to influence service architecture, operational strategy, and platform evolution.
Career growth through ownership, technical leadership, and collaboration with world-class engineering teams.
Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and flexible work arrangements.

*This position requires to be onsite in Nashville, TN. Relocation assistance will be provided*
OCI Incident Response is the first line of defense in maintaining the high availability of Oracle’s cloud. We minimize customer-impacting events by making them shorter, less frequent, and less impactful through large-scale incident management. We are at the forefront of reducing event duration by leveraging our operational experience, knowledge of best practices, and ability to develop tools that automate incident management.
Description
We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our OCI team. This role is part of a globally distributed team responsible for detecting, triaging, and mitigating OCI service-impacting events as quickly as possible. You will be part of one of these regional teams and will be responsible for minimizing the downtime of OCI services. You will achieve this by delivering excellent major incident management and operating systems with high scalability, performance, and security that help prevent incidents from occurring.
Oracle’s Cloud is state-of-the-art and constantly evolving. When issues arise, your team will respond within minutes to ensure customer impact is minimized. This role will expose you to the inner workings of OCI’s systems and organization. You will interact with and influence leaders across Oracle and drive broad, cross-organization programs aimed at iteratively improving OCI-wide service availability. We are an agile team with significant impact. If you want to be part of a fast-moving team breaking new ground, we would love to speak with you!
We are looking for candidates who are flexible to work AMER shift hours (9:30 AM to 5:30 PM PST) on a rotating roster, including occasional weekends and public holidays.
